A pessoa que está assistindo isso não acredita em você!”\n[耶稣/温和慈祥醇厚男声，巴西葡萄牙语]：“Mostre que ela mente. integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, documentary realism, vertical framing, broadcast-grade handheld ENG portable camera with a breaking-news live feel, natural ambient light capture. A low-angle medium shot slowly pushes in toward the ancient heavy log door of a small stone snow-mountain church set on a weathered-rock gobi avenue on a high plateau; ink-black storm clouds press low toward the ground, fierce wind tears at dry grass, and fresh tire tracks streak across the gravel road, all under crisp Alpine morning light with cold, clean air. A little girl with slightly curly twin ponytails, wearing a wine-red wool pinafore dress over a white shirt, her cheeks flushed red by the plateau wind, hurries up in small steps and knocks hard on the rusty cast-iron door knocker, wood grain cracks and iron rust rendered in fine detail. The heavy wooden door swings open and Jesus, in a white robe shawl over a light camel distressed heavy linen cardigan with a frayed pilling collar, neatly trimmed curly beard and labor-worn hands, calmly leans out surrounded by a soft warm glow. The girl nimbly spins around, thrusts her chubby little index finger straight at the lens, and loudly tattles to Jesus — the crisp childlike girl (S1) says: <d>[Portuguese] Veja só, Senhor! A pessoa que está assistindo isso não acredita em você!</d> — with precise lip-sync. Jesus's eyes fill with boundless loving-kindness; he smiles directly into the screen and gently soothes — the gentle, kind, mellow male voice of Jesus (S2) says: <d>[Portuguese] Mostre que ela mente. Aperte todos os botões ao lado e comente amém.</d> — again with accurate lip-sync and extremely natural facial micro-expressions. Mid-shot, the handheld camera performs one brief real zoom pull before settling.

overall_soundscape: Fierce plateau wind howls and rattles dry grass while low thunder rumbles in the distance. The rusty cast-iron knocker strikes the log door with sharp metallic knocks, the heavy wooden door groans open, and gravel crunches under small hurrying footsteps.
